registry_disposition.reason: Scope is the S10 implementation slice of the MAWS-SII development lane: the qualification-bound cross-model comparison contract and engine with typed INCOMPARABLE/BLOCKED refusals, the absolute security exclusion, the integrated S9 regression gate, the instruction-overhead measurement field, the derived provider/harness difference classification, the adapter-boundary rule for model-specific optimizations, the independent 17-case corpus with its runner and validator, the contract fixtures, the test suite, the specification section, the changelog and the workflow wiring. material_change is true: durable repository artifacts changed (a new canonical contract under core/contracts/, a new runtime module, two new tools, the independent case corpus, a new contract fixture family, the test suite, the specification section, the changelog and the workflow). registry_relevant_change is true because the slice creates one canonical contract under core/contracts/ - core/contracts/cross-model-comparison.schema.json - whose CONTRACT_RECORD projection the Registry must carry, and because the run itself requires a change registration. The status is REQUIRED_BUT_BLOCKED at the evidence commit by sequencing, not by obstacle: the Registry is a read-only projection over owner-repository truth, so the CONTRACT_RECORD binds the observed owner merge state and the registry write can only follow the owner merge. The rebind commit on the lane binds registry_commit_sha and flips the status to UPDATED once the registration is merged and observed. No part of the registration is skipped or postponed as cleanup: owner merge, Registry projection, Atlas representation and cross-surface verification form one change set.
